answer: Start with Granted cybersecurity analyst licence with cyber security attestation. The idea is simple: a licence security officers renew after incident audits, and that dawn alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence security officers renew after incident audits — so privacy survives, and the signal is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the pigment for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
